data_contract.cross_file_duplicate_cluster_rule: bind the complete equivalence cluster to one fold; current cluster count is zero
data_contract.official_test_policy: hash/schema/identity and final inference/export only; never use numerical distribution or predictions for selection

primary.purpose: interpolation estimate and common outer split registry for all questions

mandatory_stress.purpose: scenario extrapolation; reported separately and never substituted for primary CV

preprocessing.learned_steps: fit only inside the current training fold
preprocessing.identifier_policy: source_file, test_id, loc_id, bss_id, names, MACs and raw AP/STA IDs are keys/strata/alignment aids, not model features
preprocessing.constant_field_policy: retain for formula/boundary checks; do not claim learned empirical effects

q1.accept_main_if: MAE improves at least 5 percent over Q1-B1 in at least two of three repeats without material LOSO instability

q2.label_order: numeric nss ascending, then numeric mcs ascending
selection: then lower log loss and complexity
q2.missing_training_class_policy: reindex probabilities to all 17 labels; absent training labels receive probability zero and cannot be predicted in that fold; disclose them
q2.conditional_weighted_candidate: one square-root inverse-frequency weighting run, capped at 5, only if O2 identifies minority collapse
q2.output_rule: predict one of the 17 fixed observed joint labels; never create an unobserved nss/mcs combination

q3.system_target: sum of per-AP throughput inside each strict source_file+test_id group
authorized_inputs: Q1 cross-fitted or inference seq_time prediction
q3.phy_rate_source: 20 MHz MCS/NSS table in the problem statement
main_architectures: direct HistGradientBoostingRegressor with physical proxy features
q3.selection_score: minimize max(AP absolute-relative-error nearest-rank 90th percentile, system absolute-relative-error nearest-rank 90th percentile)
q3.tie_break: lower normalized AP/system MAE, then smaller model
q3.signed_metric_bias_guard: absolute median signed relative error at either level must not worsen by more than 0.02
q3.system_consistency: system prediction is always the sum of exported AP predictions; no independent system head
q3.prediction_bound: per-AP throughput >= 0; report raw and bounded validation predictions
q3.a03_phy_rate_policy: 0|0 has undefined PHY rate; retain with missing-rate indicator in primary analysis and run whole-group exclusion sensitivity

q3_metric_contract.error_90: ascending error at one-indexed rank ceil(0.90*n); no interpolation
q3_metric_contract.tie_rule: retain all observations and use the fixed nearest-rank position
q3_metric_contract.zero_truth: exclude from relative CDF and ERROR_90, disclose count, report absolute error separately

current_allowed_actions: split registry generation from training identities
